title: The Bone Dice
text: A skeleton in a gambler's coat sits at a table set for two, a cup of dice by its finger bones. Coins of every age are stacked at its elbow. Its jaw clicks as you approach: one throw. It has all the time in the world, and none of you do.

options.label: The Leader plays it honestly, and leaves the throw to fate.

outcomes.text: Sixes. The skeleton pays out with a clatter and a bow, seeming almost pleased to lose.
Ones. It takes its winnings along with a little of your nerve, stacking both neatly at its elbow.

options.label: The craftiest plays, and cheats. A skull cannot watch your hands that closely.

outcomes.text: It never notices, or perhaps it enjoys losing to a good cheat. With a skull, it is hard to tell.
It sees. Its jaw stops clicking, and the silence that follows is far worse.

options.label: Decline its game. Some tables are better left empty.

outcomes.text: It shrugs with a long rattle, then throws for you anyway. As you walk away, you hear the dice come up bad.

options.label: The Gambler takes the cup, unable to turn down a game like this.

outcomes.text: Sixes. The skeleton's jaw falls off. It pays in old gold while the Gambler walks away with luck humming in their fingers.
Ones. It laughs until its ribs rattle, then takes its winnings out of the Gambler's blood.
